name: Devanagari Handwriting Benchmark
description: A new benchmark dataset for offline handwriting recognition in the Devanagari script.
reputation: Moderately used in academic research on Indic handwriting recognition; recognized in the literature but not a widely adopted large-scale industry benchmark.
notes: Script-specific, relatively small dataset focused on offline handwriting (non-LLM). Possible class imbalance and saturation on isolated character recognition; moderate contamination risk.
